Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
About The Company
 We're a software craftsmanship company and we're partnering with startups and enterprises to create profitable digital products and ventures.
Here at Graffino we strive to bring out the best each of us has to offer .
 We Have Come To Value
Continuous growth over complacency
Integrity and honesty over short term gains
Generating a meaningful impact over futility
Innovation and openness over keeping the status quo
 About The Role
 We are recruiting on behalf of Rurio, one of our partner companies, in which Graffino is a shareholder. Rurio is building a digital platform for smart agriculture that helps farmers plan their work, monitor crops using satellite imagery and receive early alerts. The position is with Rurio, and you'll work closely with the Graffino team.
We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong TypeScript skills to work on this web platform, with a NestJS backend and a React frontend . You'll work on features end to end, from API design and database work to responsive, polished user interfaces.
The role starts with the platform's launch period (November 2026 – May 2027), with the possibility of extension.
If you're confident with TypeScript, have shipped NestJS (or Node.js) and React to production, and enjoy writing clean, tested code, we'd love to meet you 🚀
 Employment Location (Sibiu, Romania):
 We require your presence in the office at least 2 times per week, with the flexibility to work remotely up to 3 days. This balance may adjust over time based on team needs.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain features across the whole platform, from the NestJS backend to the React frontend
Turn product designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces that work well on any device
Build and improve REST APIs and the database layer, keeping the platform fast, secure and reliable
Write clean, well-tested and maintainable code that follows the team's standards
Take part in code reviews and work closely with the product and development teams at Rurio and Graffino
Contribute to planning and estimating work, and help improve the product continuously
 Required Skills And Expertise
3+ years of professional experience in full-stack development with TypeScript
Proven experience delivering at least one NestJS or Node.js backend and one React frontend to production
Solid, hands-on TypeScript skills
Experience building backend services with NestJS, including modules, guards and DTO validation, as well as designing clean REST APIs
Experience developing modern user interfaces with React (hooks, state management) and Tailwind CSS
Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, working with an ORM (ideally TypeORM) and managing database migrations
Experience working with Docker-based local development environments
Experience writing automated tests with Jest
Comfortable with a Git-based workflow, including pull requests and code reviews
Fluency in Romanian and English, as the product and the team work in both languages
 Nice to have
Experience with Playwright for end-to-end testing
Experience with maps and GIS technologies (GeoJSON, Leaflet or MapLibre)
Experience using AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code, in your daily work
 What You Get
Flexible work hours to help you maintain work-life balance
Hybrid work: two days a week in our Sibiu office
Your very own MacBook Pro and Monitor, Apple Keyboard & Mouse
Great colleagues that help you settle in and offer support
Clear work flow, and all the tools you need to do your work
Opportunities for professional growth and development
 How To Apply
 If you have a strong background in TypeScript, NestJS and React, we'd love to hear from you! 🚀
Best of luck,
Graffino Team 🤞
